description.value: Isami Sushi is a family-run Japanese restaurant that has served the Burnaby community near Metrotown since 1991, growing from a small family kitchen into a multi-generational neighborhood fixture. Located at basement level along Kingsway, it offers a curated menu built on over 30 years of culinary experience. Free underground parking is available on site.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: rack (4 spaces) at 49m; rack (4 spaces) at 75m; stands (10 spaces) at 99m. Total: 18 spaces.
